name: How long does garage wall framing usually take?
description: Simple garage wall framing may take a few days, but permitting, structural repairs, and add-ons like door openings can stretch the timeline.

mainEntity.name: How long does garage wall framing usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Timing depends on whether you are framing one wall, a full garage interior, or a detached structure, but many standard garage wall framing jobs can be completed in a few days once materials are on site. Delays usually come from permitting, structural changes, or waiting on other work like foundation repair or overhead door installation.
